archetypes.description: Before/After — disconnected AI tools need one operating system before they work as a team.
archetypes.research_map: Before/after split; contrast tension; transformation storytelling (Hooksnap 2026-05-07).

archetypes.description: Build It — a real AI department is built from roles, context, standards, workflows.
archetypes.research_map: Numbered build steps act as a time contract / payoff moments (Blitzcut 2026-06-06).

archetypes.description: Contrast statement hook — 'X works. Y doesn't.' keyword in accent color; pattern interrupt (Hooksnap format B).
archetypes.research_map: Pattern interrupt / bold contrast hooks; first-2s window; centered key element >=1s (Tukey 2026-05-26; JAMS 2026-03-26).

archetypes.description: Three-panel storyboard progression (Problem -> Turn -> Result) with numbered frames.
archetypes.research_map: Scene cuts boost attention, ~5% synchrony loss per extra scene second; keep scenes short and simple (JAMS 2026-03-26).

archetypes.description: One hero fact/statistic with a counting number and a supporting line; bold claim + proof point.
archetypes.research_map: Currency/number anchors + proof point raise hook quality (viralfaceless 2026-05-10); bold claim hook (Tukey 2026-05-26).

archetypes.description: Open-loop question hook — the question lands on screen before speech; curiosity gap.
archetypes.research_map: Curiosity gap hooks (Tukey 2026-05-26); open-loop markers add the biggest curiosity boost (viralfaceless 2026-05-10).

archetypes.description: Flat canvas — journey line through department stations, loop symbol GOAL->OBSERVE->DECIDE->ACT->EVALUATE, goal bullseye, centered Outfit 800 title.
archetypes.research_map: Images are the strongest Threads format; consistent brand template builds recognition (Buffer 2026-02-10; vidIQ 2026-05-28).

archetypes.description: Hook-first single fact — one bold claim/number in the title band, one supporting line, journey signature.
archetypes.research_map: One clear powerful message beats a carousel; first line is the hook window (Sendible 2025-08-26; Socialync 2026-05-14).

archetypes.description: Checklist/list layout — numbered rows with boxicon bullets under a hook title; flat, no card-with-arrows.
archetypes.research_map: Carousel/step-by-step content; short snappy segments; 5-8 words per item (Sendible 2025-08-26; RocketShip 2026-06-08).

archetypes.description: Pull-quote layout — large quoted line, attribution line, journey signature; conversation-first tone.
archetypes.research_map: Conversation starters and personal proof outperform announcements on Threads (Postory 2026-04-15; Murat Esmer 2026-03-18).

archetypes.description: Centered five-column OperatingLoop rail — GOAL->OBSERVE->DECIDE->ACT->EVALUATE nodes riding a gradient progress line.
archetypes.research_map: Process/loop visualization; step-by-step mapping keeps viewers oriented (JAMS 2026-03-26; Sendible 2025-08-26).

archetypes.description: Live heartbeat card — centered north star, run row, and a 2x2 stat grid over a minimal magical pulse.
archetypes.research_map: Live-ops/status storytelling; credible live numbers and current work outshine static claims (goal-live-heartbeat-clean-20260818).

archetypes.description: DepartmentMap hub — branch tile grid showing the company's real departments as connected stations.
archetypes.research_map: System/harness visualization; images are the strongest Threads format and a consistent brand template builds recognition (Buffer 2026-02-10; vidIQ 2026-05-28).

archetypes.description: Seven-step Agent Brief pipeline with a flat deliverable/milestone showcase rail (no form UI).
archetypes.research_map: Assessment/request flow; a clear request journey converts better than a bare announcement (goal-creative-variety-v2-polish-20260818).

archetypes.description: YouTube 1280×720 thumbnail — big hybrid titles: bold 800 statement with accent keyword + primary rule + stat card + chip row, catchy 16:9 safe.
archetypes.research_map: Hybrid of contrast-text (accent + rule) + data-card (number anchor) + single-fact (one clear message); pattern-interrupt / bold-contrast hooks win first-2s (Tukey 2026-05-26); 92% sound-off (viralfaceless 2026-05-10); survives at 154px preview.

archetypes.description: YouTube 1920×1080 horizontal — big-title hybrid: contrast statement + hero number card + claim/proof, flat 16:9 big-type for YouTube in-player.
archetypes.research_map: Hybrid of contrast-text + data-card + loop-rail; bold claim hooks; number anchors; centered key element >=1s (JAMS 2026-03-26); 16:9 horizontal for YouTube.

archetypes.description: One-idea Brand Infrastructure stack: build once, execute everywhere, with tokens/components/templates as the mechanism.
archetypes.research_map: Direct-response campaign brief: brand assets become executable infrastructure and repeated formats inherit one source of truth.

archetypes.description: Five-stop journey from identity through tokens, components, templates, and consistent outputs.
archetypes.research_map: Direct-response campaign brief: build once, execute everywhere; process journey keeps the mechanism legible in short video.

archetypes.description: LinkedIn landscape thought-leadership post — a decisive point of view, one short operational proof, and the journey signature. Exports at 1.91:1 and 16:9.
archetypes.research_map: LinkedIn favors a clear first-line hook with a practical takeaway; this landscape format holds one strong claim and a scannable mechanism.

archetypes.description: LinkedIn landscape RTL thought-leadership post — Persian-first hierarchy, one operational proof, and a mirrored journey signature. Exports at 1.91:1 and 16:9.
archetypes.research_map: LinkedIn favors a clear first-line hook with a practical takeaway; the RTL companion preserves that hierarchy for Persian audiences.
